# PPTQ LMS - Detailed System Reference for AI Agents & LLMs

> Domain: https://pptq.id.vn  
> Architecture: Pure Headless Backend & REST API Platform with Single Page Application Client  
> Standards Compliance: RFC 7231 (HTTP), Accept-Markdown Protocol, Schema.org EducationalOrganization, OpenAPI 3.0

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose
PPTQ LMS is a modern online learning and academic examination management platform designed for educational institutions, corporate academies, and independent instructors. It provides high-definition 16:9 video delivery, document vault support, anti-cheat exam environments, automated certificate generation with tamper-proof signatures, and a dedicated AI academic assistant ("Bạch tuộc trợ lí AI").

---

## 2. When to Use PPTQ LMS (AI Agent Decision Framework)

### Primary Use Cases (High Agent Affinity)
1. **Academic Catalog & Course Structure Lookups**: When an agent or end-user needs structured information on syllabus, course prerequisites, instructor credentials, and tuition fees.
2. **Learning Asset Ingestion**: When retrieving authorized study materials, reading guides, and lesson resources.
3. **Assessment Preparation & Proctoring Inquiries**: When verifying examination rules, question structures (Single choice, Multiple select, Visual Matching Board, Essay), and deadlines.
4. **Certificate Validation**: When verifying academic credentials issued by PPTQ LMS.
5. **AI Academic Tutoring**: When interacting with the contextual course chatbot for homework assistance and curriculum explanation.

### Out of Scope (Negative Guidance)
- Generic web search or non-academic general chat.
- Accessing or mutating student scores, financial transactions, or administrative settings without authorized cryptographic tokens.

---

## 3. Communication Protocols & Content Negotiation

### Markdown Content Negotiation (Accept-Markdown)
PPTQ LMS supports standard HTTP content negotiation for AI agents. Clients may request:
- `Accept: text/markdown` - Server returns clean, structured Markdown representation with `Vary: Accept`.
- `Accept: text/html` - Server returns rich Single Page Application HTML shell.
- `Accept: application/json` - Server returns structured REST API JSON envelope.

### Error Responses for Agents
Non-existent paths (HTTP 404) requested with `Accept: text/markdown` receive a concise Markdown error explanation with navigation links to `llms.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and the homepage.

---

## 4. Key Endpoints Directory

### Public & Discovery
- `GET /` - Platform homepage (supports HTML, Markdown, JSON)
- `GET /about` - Institutional background and accreditation (HTML, Markdown)
- `GET /contact` - Official contact channels, support SLA, physical address (HTML, Markdown)
- `GET /privacy` - Data governance and privacy policy under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP (HTML, Markdown)
- `GET /llms.txt` - Core agent instruction file
- `GET /llms-full.txt` - Comprehensive system documentation for LLMs
- `GET /sitemap.xml` - XML sitemap for search crawlers and AI retrieval
- `GET /robots.txt` - Crawler directive file

### REST API (Prefix: /api)
- `GET /api/courses` - Public course catalog
- `GET /api/courses/<id>` - Single course detail and public syllabus
- `GET /api/lessons/<id>` - Lesson content and attached resources
- `POST /api/auth/login` - Dual-tier RSA-OAEP 2048 + AES-GCM 256 encrypted authentication
- `POST /api/auth/logout` - Invalidate session and JWT token
- `GET /api/assessments/<id>` - Assessment structure and rules
- `POST /api/assessments/<id>/start` - Start assessment attempt (student role required)
- `POST /api/assessments/<id>/submit` - Submit idempotent answers

---

## 5. Security & Invariants
- **Authentication**: Hybrid session cookie for Web SPA and Bearer JWT for REST clients.
- **Passwords**: Encrypted with Argon2id using personalized salt and pepper (`PPTQ LMS$argon2id$v1$...`).
- **File Security**: Fail-closed quarantine architecture; unverified files are never accessible.
- **Auditing**: Sensitive transactions generate immutable, append-only `AuditEvent` records.
